-- Info --

This archive contains source code and assembly for a custom BIOS replacement for the Nintendo DS system. This code is in no way affiliated with Nintendo and is not derived from Nintendo's BIOS implementation but has been implemented using publically available documentation.

It can be assembled using the included Makefile along with a proper ARM gcc toolchain. Change the first four lines to point to the proper toolchain of your choice.
